title: Base colour palette
description: The main colours of the guest app, business portal and landing page. Pick the one that feels right for the Overstrand. All six are shown live in the Style lab.

options.label: Fynbos: deep teal with lime
options.note: The current default. Fresh and coastal.

options.label: Graphite: charcoal and grey
options.note: Neutral, lets each business's brand lead.

title: Accent colour
description: The colour used for highlights, buttons and progress.

title: Badge and stamp style
description: How passport stamps and badges look and move. Animated styles are lighter on phones than they look.

title: How a recorded trip is shown
description: Guests who opt in can replay a trip on a map with the route drawn as they moved. The 3D view is only used here, not across the whole app.

options.label: Animated 3D with a switch to a flat map
options.note: Recommended. Works on older phones too.

title: Guest app layout
description: The guest app has four areas: Stay, Explore, Trips and Wallet. Phone first with a tab bar, and a sidebar layout on desktop.

options.label: Version 1: concierge page with Your stay, Explore and Offers

title: Landing page direction
description: The public page that explains TapIt to guesthouses and operators, with a working demo.

options.label: Version 2: clean page with a live demo phone

title: Business portal editor
description: Where a business edits its concierge page. Content is written here, so this decides how easy that feels.

options.label: Version 2: blocks with a live phone preview

title: Admin overview and billing
description: How the TapIt team sees the network, and how referral commission and subscriptions are invoiced to businesses. TapIt never handles guest payments.
